svg.text: 3 Whole-layout choices: concepts, not tested shapes
All three retain user-facing input/force behavior and must prove natural play plus equal-or-better continuous aim range.
A Keep the current play skeleton
Keep current shooter / roof / nose / bats.
Preserve terminal heel and wire handoff.
Explore earlier coupled IN + OUT transition.
Mounts and outside collection stay in scope.
RELATIONSHIP SKETCH / NOT TO SCALE
Base: tested play; reference incomplete.
Any new transition is still unproved.
Limit: no promise of reference-long lanes.
Unknown: IN arrival / wire / save axis.
Reject: cosmetic-only elongation.
B Redistribute width as one system
Allocate width to both IN and OUT.
Co-design board, straight shooter and exit.
Include nose access, bars, sensors, supports.
Keep current bat / heel as a chosen baseline.
RELATIONSHIP SKETCH / NOT TO SCALE
Section room may exist; route is unproved.
Cost: entrance and lower return are coupled.
Unknown: all-height connector + natural feed.
Reject: rigid roof shift / repeat R1.70 wedge.
C Replan the mechanical topology
Allow pivot / heel / drain locations to change.
First compare current bat length (~1.14).
Do not silently require old center opening.
Decide if raised mouth is entry or return.
RELATIONSHIP SKETCH / NOT TO SCALE
Layout freedom, not proven viability.
Cost: save, difficulty, capture and aim requalify.
If mouth returns: another natural ascent needed.
No portal, hidden floor or automatic rescue.
Fixed outcomes vs selectable geometry
MUST KEEP: keyboard/touch semantics, force contract, natural weak/medium/strong feed, real IN capture then release/repress refire,
OUT drain and earned kickback, shared visible/contact boundaries, equal-or-better continuous aim coverage, reference quality and mobile.
NOT absolute user constraints: old pivot X/Z, exact center gap, board width/length, old shooter axis, or the reference mouth being an entry.
Illustration only: each pivot +.400 outward with the SAME bat/angle increases projected rest gap .590694 -> 1.390694.
The older ~1.625 bat calculation additionally FIXED the old opening; it is not a required bat length or an impossibility proof.
FIRST DECISION: choose route topology and which datums may move. No concept is qualified for adoption by this sheet.
Then: shared all-height corridor + reference views -> six natural powers / weak return -> IN capture/refire + OUT save ->
strong shots + original aim matrix -> full regression / controller games -> real phone and human play. Preserve every failed assertion.
No independent geometry improvement is currently qualified for adoption. A useful proposal is evidence/diagram tooling, not a cosmetic patch.
SOURCE: accepted c1f7aeb at docs HEAD 4b3b4f0. Model units, not manufacturer dimensions. No new geometry or dynamic test.
